title: The Case of the Crossword
story: The night before press day, someone changed three answers in Ada's crossword, and the Gazette came within one proofread of printing GULL as a kind of cheese. Five visitors used the puzzle desk that evening, each at a different time, with a different pen and a different snack. Inkwell the cat was a suspect for about a minute. All three changes are in green ink. Who scrambled the crossword?

texts: Of Otis and Faye, one stopped by at 5:00 p.m. and the other stopped by at 6:30 p.m.
Of the visitor with the purple pen and the visitor who stopped by at 5:30 p.m., one brought pretzels and the other brought almonds.
The visitor who brought almonds stopped by earlier than the visitor who brought grapes.
Of Tariq and the visitor with the black pen, one brought grapes and the other brought pretzels.
The visitor who stopped by at 6:00 p.m. carried either the blue or the green pen.
The visitor who brought popcorn stopped by at either 5:30 p.m. or 6:30 p.m.
The five visitors were the visitor who stopped by at 5:30 p.m., the visitor who brought almonds, the visitor who brought grapes, Otis, and the visitor with the blue pen.
Wren stopped by later than the visitor who brought grapes.
